fieldNotes.location: Roster address (1080 Old Philadelphia Rd) was approximate (geocode RANGE_INTERPOLATED). Web research and OpenStreetMap resolved the operating address to 800 Hickory Dr, Aberdeen MD 21001; OSM tags the Frito-Lay building at 39.49876,-76.188679. Street View confirmed the 'Frito-Lay, Inc.' monument sign and Cheetos-branded trailers at the dock.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (2024 pano on Hickory Dr) clearly shows a barrier arm across the single truck driveway with continuous chain-link perimeter fencing - controlled truck gate confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small structure sits beside the gate barrier arm in both Street View and z21 satellite, but it reads as a small check-in kiosk/booth (~1-vehicle footprint) rather than a clearly staffed multi-window guard shack. Classified remoteGs (gate, no clear staffed shack); flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed into dock doors on the west, north, south, and east building faces in satellite imagery; total door count well into the 50+ band (~70 estimated, approximate).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer drop yard on the SW/south side - long rows of parked trailers, easily 50+ stalls.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the NW edge of the property; a spur appears to reach the plant's NW corner near the bulk ingredient tanks. Frito-Lay Aberdeen is a manufacturing-distribution center that historically received rail inbound. Flagged uncertain - the spur may serve only the adjacent corridor.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Aberdeen is a small Harford County city; the plant sits in a wooded edge-of-town industrial park. Classified Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large connected manufacturing-distribution building; counted as 1 despite multiple roof sections.
